name: DKCTF Hard Mode – direct native P2 selector
notes: Try 5 bypasses mRuntimeData.Char_P2 and the normal two-player character selection. The AVM2 slider calls a renamed one-argument native callback. That callback maps selector state 0..4 with the game's native Kong table and stores the final internal Kong ID in the Hard Mode transition state at +0x26C0. Hard Mode initialization then consumes that exact ID instead of generating the automatic DK/default partner.

entries.description: Preserve the confirmed independent-P2 Hard Mode state.
Load the directly stashed P2 Kong ID from state +0x26C0 instead of creating automatic P2 ID 1.
Remove the DK-specific increment that converts the automatic P2 ID from 1 to 2.
Preserve the active P2 slot bit during Hard Mode initialization.

Replace the unused UpdateCharacterTypes callback body with a one-argument handler: parse the slider integer, map 0..4 through native 0x27BE44, get the frontend state via 0x32F66C, and store the internal Kong ID at +0x26C0.
Do not clear the direct P2 stash at state +0x26C0 before Hard Mode initialization consumes it.
Rename the unused UpdateCharacterTypes ExternalInterface registration to Char_P2 and change its declared argument count from 0 to 1; the callback function pointer remains 0x3457A8.
